title: Who's in the lead?
subtitle: Every check-in and every donation adds up. See where you stand for the season.

error.title: We couldn't load the leaderboard

empty.title: The board is just getting started
empty.body: No one has points yet this season — be the first to check in at an event and claim the top spot.

myStanding.rankUnavailable: Your rank will show up here as soon as points are recorded.

prize.headline: Top of the board when the season ends wins $400, cash.
prize.body: Every check-in and every donation you bring adds points toward the title. Full contest rules and eligibility are on our terms page.

howItWorks.heading: How points work
howItWorks.checkIn: Check in at an event and you earn points just for showing up.
howItWorks.donationBonus: Bring a donation for that week's beneficiary and earn a bonus on top.

cta.body: Not on the board yet? Every event is a chance to climb it.
